run_deep_mimic_walk_env: run the HumanoidDeepMimicWalkBulletEnv-v1 gym environment with random actions in an infinite loop
run_deep_mimic_backflip_env: run the HumanoidDeepMimicBackflipBulletEnv-v1 gym environment with random actions in an infinite loop
profile_pybullet_env_timings: start state logging with STATE_LOGGING_PROFILE_TIMINGS to profile pybullet environment performance to perf.json
submit_profile_timing_marker: submit a named profile timing marker such as loop to the pybullet client logger
step_env_with_random_action: sample a random action from the env action space and step the environment to get state reward done and info
